fullContentHtml:
RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the short notice for the post of Paramedical Staff. This recruitment has been issued for 2626 posts. Online applying process for RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 will be started from 18 February 2025 & the candidates can apply till 19 March 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date : 12 December 2024
  • Application Start Date : 18 February 2025
  • Last Date : 19 March 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 March 2025
  • Correction Date : Available Soon
  • Exam Date : Notified Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer) : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Online Form 2025?

RSMSSB Paramedical Staff Online Form 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 19 March 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
